quality.title: Quality Coach
quality.hint_tooShort: Title is too short. Name the outcome precisely (e.g. "Increase eNPS from 12 to 20").
quality.hint_vagueStem: Vague phrasing — add a benchmark like "from X to Y" so the outcome is concrete.
quality.hint_activityPrefix: This reads like an activity, not an outcome. State the result, not the action ("Increase satisfaction by 15%" instead of "Organize 3 workshops").
quality.hint_tieToParent: Link this objective to a parent so it ladders up to a higher-level goal.
quality.hint_pickMetric: Pick a metric type (Percentage, Number, Currency, or Boolean).
quality.hint_numericTarget: Set a numeric target value — without a number this KR can't be scored.
quality.hint_booleanTarget: Boolean KRs use target 1 (done) — pair with a clear "done" definition.
quality.hint_targetPositive: Target must be greater than zero.
quality.hint_addUnit: Add a unit (e.g. "days", "%", "USD", "score") so the number has meaning.
quality.hint_addDueDate: Add a due date so progress is time-boxed.
quality.hint_dueBeforeCycleEnd: Due date must be on or before the cycle end ({{date}}).
